findings.description: If a pending subscription PUT succeeds after settings is hidden/backgrounded, it still starts the two fresh GETs. Account generation guards remain, and no background consent dialog or automatic enable occurs.
findings.disposition: Known in already submitted 0.1.2 candidate; defer reads until foreground in a later small optimization.

limitations: Static and isolated state-machine review does not replace actual Huawei delivery or formal distribution privacy testing.
